es: Convertir peticiones sueltas en propuestas de intercambio con in exchange for, on the understanding that e if you could…, we could….

vocabulary.es: sacrificar una cosa a cambio de otra
mejorar la oferta para que resulte atractiva

teaching.en: We are willing to sign for two years in exchange for a lower rent, because a long contract gives the landlord real security.
teaching.es: Estamos dispuestos a firmar dos años a cambio de un alquiler más bajo, porque un contrato largo da al propietario una seguridad real.
teaching.explanationEs: Be willing to + verbo muestra que cedes; in exchange for + nombre señala lo que recibes.
segments: We are willing to sign for two years in exchange for a
lower rent, because a long contract gives the landlord real security.
teaching.audioText: We are willing to sign for two years in exchange for a lower rent, because a long contract gives the landlord real security.

teaching.en: The landlord will waive the deposit on the understanding that the rent is paid on the first of each month, without any reminders.
teaching.es: El propietario renunciará al depósito con la condición de que el alquiler se pague el día uno de cada mes, sin recordatorios.
teaching.explanationEs: On the understanding that + cláusula con sujeto: condición que queda clara desde el principio.
segments: The landlord will waive the deposit on the understanding that the rent
is paid on the first of each month, without any reminders.
teaching.audioText: The landlord will waive the deposit on the understanding that the rent is paid on the first of each month, without any reminders.

teaching.en: If you could include parking, we could accept the whole package, which already covers the lower rent and the longer contract.
teaching.es: Si pudieras incluir el aparcamiento, podríamos aceptar todo el paquete, que ya recoge el alquiler más bajo y el contrato más largo.
teaching.explanationEs: If you could…, we could… es una propuesta suave y condicional; package = conjunto de peticiones.
segments: If you could include parking, we could accept the whole package,
which already covers the lower rent and the longer contract.
teaching.audioText: If you could include parking, we could accept the whole package, which already covers the lower rent and the longer contract.

teaching.en: I am willing to move my holiday dates if you reciprocate by paying for the hotel, so that neither of us loses out.
teaching.es: Estoy dispuesto a cambiar mis fechas de vacaciones si tú correspondes pagando el hotel, de modo que ninguno de los dos salga perdiendo.
teaching.explanationEs: Reciprocate = devolver un gesto con otro equivalente.
segments: I am willing to move my holiday dates if you reciprocate by
paying for the hotel, so that neither of us loses out.
teaching.audioText: I am willing to move my holiday dates if you reciprocate by paying for the hotel, so that neither of us loses out.

teaching.en: Try to bundle several small requests into one offer, because a neat bundle can sweeten the deal more than one big demand.
teaching.es: Intenta agrupar varias peticiones pequeñas en una sola oferta, porque un paquete bien armado puede mejorar el trato más que una gran exigencia.
teaching.explanationEs: Bundle = agrupar; sweeten the deal = hacer la oferta más atractiva para la otra parte.
segments: Try to bundle several small requests into one offer, because a
neat bundle can sweeten the deal more than one big demand.
teaching.audioText: Try to bundle several small requests into one offer, because a neat bundle can sweeten the deal more than one big demand.

teaching.en: A stipulation is a condition that must be met, and good negotiations rely on give and take, so each side has to trade off one demand against another.
teaching.es: Una condición exigida (stipulation) debe cumplirse, y las buenas negociaciones se basan en ceder por ambas partes, así que cada lado debe sacrificar una exigencia para ganar otra.
teaching.explanationEs: Stipulation = requisito; give and take = concesiones mutuas; trade off = renunciar a algo a cambio de otra cosa.
segments: A stipulation is a condition that must be met, and good negotiations rely on
give and take, so each side has to trade off one demand against another.
teaching.audioText: A stipulation is a condition that must be met, and good negotiations rely on give and take, so each side has to trade off one demand against another.

prompt.es: Elige la propuesta de intercambio que une las dos peticiones.

choices.text: We are willing to sign for three years in exchange for a lower rent.
We are willing to sign for three years in exchange of a lower rent.
We are willing to sign for three years on the understanding to pay less.

feedback.es: «In exchange for» es la fórmula correcta para un intercambio; «in exchange of» es un calco y «understanding to pay» no lleva that + cláusula.

hint.es: Busca la fórmula con for; on the understanding necesita that + sujeto.

origin.text: The tenant asks for a lower rent. The landlord asks for a longer contract. They want to turn these two separate requests into one offer.

prompt.es: Completa: «Renunciará al depósito con la condición de que se pague el día uno.»

feedback.es: On the understanding that + cláusula es la fórmula fija para fijar una condición.

hint.es: Es la preposición que abre la fórmula on the understanding that.

origin.text: The landlord wants the rent on time every month. He will waive the deposit ___ the understanding that the rent is paid on the first.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si pudieras pagar antes de marzo, podríamos aceptar el paquete.»

answer.text: If you could pay by March we could accept the package

feedback.es: If you could…, we could… forma una propuesta suave: condición con could y resultado con could.

hint.es: Empieza con la condición y la coma separa el resultado.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige qué ofrece Tom a cambio del descuento.

choices.text: A payment on the first of every month.
A commitment to stay for two years.
The work of painting the kitchen himself.

feedback.es: Tom ofrece firmar dos años; pagar el día uno es la condición de Sara y pintar la cocina lo hará ella.

origin.audio: Tom and Sara spent an hour negotiating a new rental contract. At first, Tom asked for a lower rent and Sara asked for a longer contract. Then Tom suggested a package: he was willing to sign for two years in exchange for a five per cent discount, on the understanding that Sara would paint the kitchen. Sara thought for a moment and answered that she could accept it if Tom could pay on the first of every month. Tom agreed, and the deal was settled.

prompt.es: Completa: «A cambio de un contrato más largo, bajará el alquiler un diez por ciento.»

feedback.es: In exchange for + nombre expresa lo que se da a cambio de otra cosa.

origin.text: We need to keep the flat, and the owner needs a reliable tenant. ___ exchange for a longer contract, he will lower the rent by ten per cent.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con la función que cumple en una propuesta.

pairs.es: señala lo que recibes a cambio
plantea una oferta suave y condicional
muestra que estás dispuesto a ceder

feedback.es: Cada fórmula tiene su función: el intercambio, la condición, la oferta suave y la disposición a ceder.

pairs.es: señala lo que recibes a cambio
plantea una oferta suave y condicional
muestra que estás dispuesto a ceder

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de Sara. ¿Qué condición pone para renunciar al depósito?

choices.text: That the contract lasts for at least two years.
That Tom pays the extra fifty dollars in full today.
That the rent arrives by the first of every month.

feedback.es: Sara renunciará al depósito «on the understanding that you pay by the first of each month»; los dos años los acepta desde el principio y nadie habla de pagar en efectivo.

origin.audio: Hi Tom, it's Sara. I have thought about your offer, and I like the idea of a two-year contract. However, the rent you suggest is a little too low for me. Here is what I can do: I will waive the deposit on the understanding that you pay by the first of each month, and if you could look after the garden, we could settle at nine hundred and fifty. Let me know whether that package works for you before Friday.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez. ¿Qué da a entender Sara sobre su actitud ante la oferta?

choices.text: That she is open to a deal, but wants some changes.
That she has already rejected the offer for good.
That she will accept anything for a two-year contract.

feedback.es: Le gusta la idea del contrato de dos años, pero el alquiler es bajo y propone su propia versión: está abierta al trato con cambios.

origin.audio: Hi Tom, it's Sara. I have thought about your offer, and I like the idea of a two-year contract. However, the rent you suggest is a little too low for me. Here is what I can do: I will waive the deposit on the understanding that you pay by the first of each month, and if you could look after the garden, we could settle at nine hundred and fifty. Let me know whether that package works for you before Friday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Estoy dispuesto a cambiar mis fechas si tú me devuelves el gesto.»

feedback.es: Be willing to + verbo muestra que estás dispuesto a ceder sin sonar débil.

origin.text: Tom wants to show that he can give something up. He says: «I am ___ to move my holiday dates if you pay for the hotel.»

prompt.es: Elige la frase con un error de patrón.

choices.text: We will waive the deposit on the understanding that you pay early.
In exchange of a longer contract, we will lower the rent.
If you could include parking, we could accept the package.

feedback.es: «In exchange of» es un calco: la fórmula correcta es in exchange for; las otras dos frases siguen bien el patrón.

prompt.es: Escucha el resumen de la directora. ¿Qué da a entender su última frase?

choices.text: That nobody will be allowed to leave the company.
That the company will pay half of the cost anyway.
That refusing the package would mean losing the courses.

feedback.es: «The alternative was no courses at all» implica que quien rechace el paquete se queda sin cursos, aunque nadie esté obligado.

origin.audio: After a long meeting, the manager summarised the deal. The company would pay for the language courses in exchange for staff staying at least two years. Employees could leave earlier, but only if they paid back half of the cost. She added that nobody was forced to accept, yet the alternative was no courses at all.

prompt.es: ¿Qué ofrece el inquilino a cambio de que se renuncie al depósito?

choices.text: The first three months of rent, paid in advance.
A contract of one year at a lower rent.
A decision on the same day he replies.

feedback.es: A cambio de que renuncien al depósito, ofrece pagar los tres primeros meses por adelantado; el contrato de un año mantiene el alquiler igual.

origin.text: Thanks for your message. We could accept a shorter contract of one year on the understanding that the rent stays the same. If you could also waive the deposit, we could sign this week. In return, we are willing to pay the first three months in advance.

prompt.es: Completa: «Las buenas negociaciones se basan en ceder ambas partes.»

feedback.es: Give and take es la expresión fija para las concesiones mutuas.

origin.text: Nobody gets everything they want. Good negotiations rely on give and ___, so that each side concedes something.
